kind: derived from observed dry-bulb and dew point (Stull 2011 wet-bulb approximation)
limitations: Stull formula valid for RH 5-99% and T -20..50 C (clipped); error ~0.3 C
No station pressure correction (small effect at Texas elevations)
Isolated spikes (>6 C from 5-hour rolling median) removed, e.g. a 32.9 C dew point at KAUS on 2000-08-01
